title: Alleged person of interest in death investigation of woman found hanging from tree arrested on unrelated charge
text:
JACKSON, Miss. (WLBT/Gray News) - An alleged person of interest in the death investigation of a woman who was found hanging from a tree has been arrested on an unrelated charge.

On Tuesday, Terence Anderson appeared in court and was charged with being a felon in possession of a firearm.

The judge set Anderson’s bond at $250,000. Anderson is in custody at the Hinds County Detention Center.

Detectives said Anderson was interviewed in connection with the death of Tasia Fortune. He denied being involved in her death but said he had an argument with her.

Fortune was found hanging in a tree Monday.

Jackson Police Department did not confirm that Anderson was a person of interest and he has not been charged in connection with Fortune’s death.
